results.content:
Only eight states give Trump an approval rating above 50% in the latest Civiqs tracking data. His approval is highest in Wyoming at 57%, followed by North Dakota at 56% and Oklahoma at 54%. Hawaii gives him his lowest rating at 19%.

Nationally, the same tracker places Trump at 36% approval and 59% disapproval.

results.content: Trump entered his second term with positive approval ratings in every state he had won by double digits. Since then, however, his standing has steadily weakened. According to the Civiqs data, his approval rating turned negative in some Republican states after he announced tariffs on U.S. trading partners in April. In Kentucky and Missouri, the shift into negative territory occurred after the Trump administration announced military action against Iran in February.
